episode_row: fallback posted a stale cached pick (Donovan) over a fresher Turner

commits.subject: feat(scheduler): re-predict at fallback before posting
commits.body:
Audit of 2026-04-12 picks revealed that the fallback deadline path was
posting stale predictions. On today's Sunday slate, Donovan + Anthony
were locked from the 13:19 ET cached cascade — but by the 13:40 ET
fallback fire, PHI's lineup had confirmed and Trea Turner (0.7426)
would have been a better primary than Donovan (0.7169). The fallback
never re-ran predictions, so Turner stayed invisible to the lock.

Fix: new _refresh_pick_at_fallback helper that calls run_and_pick
right before the fallback post. If the fresh top pick differs from
the cached one, log "FALLBACK REFRESH: pick CHANGED OLD → NEW" and
persist the fresh daily to disk. If the refresh fails or returns no
result, fall back to the cached pick so the lock is always robust.

Both fallback call sites (per-game loop fallback ~line 755 and final
fallback ~line 790) now call the helper.

Tests: 5 new TestRefreshPickAtFallback cases — happy path (pick
changes), log verification (CHANGED in stderr), unchanged pick
(logs "unchanged"), exception fallback, None result fallback. All
use mocked run_and_pick so the test doesn't hit the MLB API.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
